detect.notes: Content-based via officeDocument relationship and main-part content type.

open.notes: Paragraphs, Title/Heading 1/Heading 2 styles, bold/italic/underline, alignment, RTL, tabs, line breaks.

inspect.notes: Unsupported content is listed when the file is opened.

save.notes: Saving a file that had unsupported content requires Save As or explicit overwrite confirmation.

knownLosses: Tables (cell text kept as paragraphs), images, drawings, embedded objects
Headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes, comments, fields, content controls
Numbering and bullets, fonts, colours, sizes, spacing, custom styles, sections
Tracked changes (insertions kept as plain text, deletions dropped)
Not validated against Microsoft Word (L5 requires an REA investigation)
